subject: Help needed: Universal binary of matrixStats v0.1.3 for Mac, please

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Help needed: Universal binary of matrixStats v0.1.3 for Mac, please
parts:
Hi,

the most recent update of aroma.affymetrix requires an update of the
'matrixStats' (to v0.1.3) package as well. This will cause problem
for people on OSX that cannot build from source. Mark Cowley kindly
help out building a binary for v0.1.2 last week. Mark, or anyone
else, could you please help out to build and forward a universal
binary of matrixStats v0.1.3. I will then make this available for
everyone on the repository.

You can get the source of latest version by:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
hbGet("matrixStats", "0.1.3", "tar.gz");

If you do not know how to build a universal binary, please see how
Mark did it in his message on July 30, 2008 in thread 'Could some
please build matrixStats_0.1.2.tgz for OSX?' [
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/browse_thread/thread/ae4323a94ce8b494
].

Thanks

Henrik

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Help needed: Universal binary of matrixStats v0.1.3 for Mac, please
parts:
Hi Mark,

thanks for this. I've uploaded a matrixStats_0.1.3.tgz (renamed from
your *i386* tgz file). I cross my fingers that
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix") will now work without flaws on all
platforms. [If it doesn't I've also uploaded the other two (i.e. you
may delete yours now), but will not give further installation
instructions unless the above default fails.]

Cheers

Henrik
